integration.source_forward_axis: muzzle toward model -X (FBX Z-up converted to Y-up by Godot's ufbx loader)
integration.source_units: metres: gun 0.2172 x 0.1418 x 0.0320 m, matching the real pistol
integration.wrapper_transform: yaw -90 degrees (model -X to game -Z), then translate so the measured bore centre (-0.1255, 0.1303, 0.0) lands on MuzzlePoint (0, 0.02, -0.18)
material_modifications: five maps bound by recipe (the FBX binds none); normal map OpenGL convention, checked against engraved slide markings under a top light
maps downscaled 4096 -> 1024 (Lanczos); occlusion, roughness and metallic packed into one ORM image; images stored as JPEG quality 0.9
runtime: metallic set to 0 by the existing weapon sanitizer (D-015); mipmaps generated
integration.modifications: Kept nodes Gun (8,609 triangles) and Magazine (1,576, seated in the grip). Dropped Gun001, a second magazine laid beside the pistol (1,576), and the empty animation take. Geometry, UVs and node transforms unchanged. Recipe: docs/assets/intake/beretta_m9/recipe.json; packer: client/scripts/assets/pack_model_glb.gd (reproducible: same sha256 on repeat runs).
